story_review.one_viewing_summary: A company-attributed drone and AI-alert pilot leads into a separately identified EPA-approved screening method. The method collects infrared footage for a certified inspector to confirm emissions and trigger follow-up. The letter's AI reference is limited to a protocol title. A separate reporting program has delayed and proposed-rescission status. The ending preserves what the letter does and does not establish.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening introduces autonomous collection and a company AI alert; the ending returns to the human-confirmed plume and leaves the AI contribution visibly unspecified.
story_review.weakest_transition: The move from the protocol limitation to the separate reporting program at 38.24 seconds is an editorial detour. The explicit separate-program disclosure and new program tag prevent an observed conflation.
